title: 1801 Prairie's 18th Street side gains its gabled balcony
items: W. W. Kimball's house at 1801 Prairie: on its 18th Street side, the tall section behind the main house now has the steep stone gable and balcony that J. W. Taylor's c. 1895 photograph shows, instead of a plain hipped roof. The section is narrower too, about 4.6 m instead of 8.5 m, and the low service range now runs up to it, as the photograph shows. Its round-arched windows, oriel and open loggia are still to come.
